# `page_item` records

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from schemas/0.1/page_item.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

Page content without electrical meaning (doc 03 §6, rank 43): a graphic, a free text, a wire marker, or a
variant this format keeps verbatim. It lives in its page's file and is deleted with its page (EW-INV-022).

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | `page_item` |
| File | `pages/<page>.jsonl` |
| Rank | 43 |
| Status | implemented |
| Record version | 1 |
| Schema | [`page_item.schema.json`](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/schemas/0.1/page_item.schema.json) |

## Types

### Ident

An identifier: non-empty, one line (no control character U+0000 to U+001F or U+007F to U+009F), without leading or trailing white space (the Unicode White_Space set); interior spaces are allowed (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express Unicode Normalization Form C; the reader rejects non-NFC text.

Type: string (at least 1 character(s))

Pattern: `^[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000](?:[^\u0000-\u001F\u007F-\u009F]*[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000])?$`

### PageItemKind

The variant of a page item: `{"graphic": {…}}`, `{"free_text": {…}}`, `{"wire_marker": {…}}`,
`{"image": {…}}` or `{"surface_view": {…}}`.

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**: A line, polyline, rectangle, circle, arc or polygon (FR-SYM-023).

   Shape: object { `graphic`: [`Graphic`](#graphic) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `graphic` | [`Graphic`](#graphic) | yes |  | A graphic without electrical meaning (doc 03 §6): a shape that carries its own geometry (no `angle`), drawn in the page's wire stroke unless `stroke` is set; an absent `dash` is solid and an absent `fill` is false (ID-566). |

2. **Form 2**: A free text, plain or bound to a project or page property (FR-SYM-024).

   Shape: object { `free_text`: [`FreeText`](#freetext) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `free_text` | [`FreeText`](#freetext) | yes |  | A free text (doc 03 §6, FR-SYM-024): `text`, or with `bind` the value the title block prints for that placeholder on the page (one of six bindable names, checked by the commands); `angle` one of 0, 90000, 180000 or 270000; `style` a text style (absent: `text.normal`); `align` the horizontal alignment at `at` (absent: left). |

3. **Form 3**: The group marker of several connections (FR-CON-023, FR-CON-039).

   Shape: object { `wire_marker`: [`WireMarker`](#wiremarker) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `wire_marker` | [`WireMarker`](#wiremarker) | yes |  | The group marker of several connections (doc 03 §6, doc 08 §4.5, FR-CON-039): it stores only the list of its connections in printed order, its position and angle (0 or 90000) and the fields it shows; the text is derived from the connections' effective values. Every listed connection exists and lies on the marker's page (EW-INV-023); a deleted connection leaves the list, and an empty marker is deleted with it. |

4. **Form 4**: An image asset placed in a rectangle (FR-SYM-025, WP-S2.04 part 5).

   Shape: object { `image`: [`ImageItem`](#imageitem) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `image` | [`ImageItem`](#imageitem) | yes |  | An image asset placed on the page (FR-SYM-025, WP-S2.04 §11): the asset's content hash (the project holds `assets/<sha256>.<ext>`, checked by `item.place`) and the rectangle it is drawn in, `rect` as `[[x0, y0], [x1, y1]]` in absolute page nanometres with `min <= max` (the reader rejects a reversed rectangle). An SVG is drawn as vector paths, a PNG or JPEG as an image. |

5. **Form 5**: The view of one mounting surface on a panel-layout page (FR-LAY-010, WP-S4.01 D9).

   Shape: object { `surface_view`: [`SurfaceView`](#surfaceview) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `surface_view` | [`SurfaceView`](#surfaceview) | yes |  | The view of one mounting surface on a panel-layout page (doc 12 §5.1, FR-LAY-010; WP-S4.01 D9): a surface point `(u, v)` is drawn at `x = datum_at.x + u / n`, `y = datum_at.y − v / n` on a page of scale 1:n (paper `y` points down), so `datum_at` is where the surface's origin lands on the page. Everything it draws (outlines, carriers, footprints, labels) is derived, never stored (doc 12 §2.3). A panel-layout page holds at most one, set by `page.surface_view.set`. Typed within format 0.1 under ADR-0011 amendment 4 (ID-334): `side`, `clip` and `layers` stay verbatim in `SurfaceView::extra`. |

### FreeText

A free text (doc 03 §6, FR-SYM-024): `text`, or with `bind` the value the title block prints for that
placeholder on the page (one of six bindable names, checked by the commands); `angle` one of 0, 90000,
180000 or 270000; `style` a text style (absent: `text.normal`); `align` the horizontal alignment at `at`
(absent: left).

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `align` | [`TextAlign`](#textalign) or `null` | no |  | The horizontal alignment at `at`; absent: left. |
| `angle` | [`Angle2`](#angle2) | no |  | The angle; default 0. |
| `at` | [`Pt2`](#pt2) | yes |  | The anchor point. |
| `bind` | [`Ident`](#ident) or `null` | no |  | The bound property (`project.description`, `page.folio`, …); absent: the text is printed. |
| `style` | [`Ident`](#ident) or `null` | no |  | The text style; absent: `text.normal`. |
| `text` | [`MlText`](#mltext) | no |  | The text; empty (omitted) for a bound text. |

### Angle2

An angle in 10^-3 degree, counter-clockwise on the sheet, within the i32 range (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: integer (min -2147483648, max 2147483647)

### Graphic

A graphic without electrical meaning (doc 03 §6): a shape that carries its own geometry (no `angle`), drawn in
the page's wire stroke unless `stroke` is set; an absent `dash` is solid and an absent `fill` is false (ID-566).

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `dash` | [`LineDash`](#linedash) | no |  | The dash pattern; default solid. |
| `fill` | boolean | no |  | Whether a closed shape (rectangle, circle, polygon) is filled; default not. |
| `shape` | [`GraphicShape`](#graphicshape) | yes |  | The shape. |
| `stroke` | [`GraphicStroke`](#graphicstroke) or `null` | no |  | The stroke; absent: the page's wire stroke. |

### GraphicShape

The shape of a graphic, absolute in page nanometres.

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**: A straight line from `a` to `b`.

   Shape: object { `line`: [`ShapeLine`](#shapeline) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `line` | [`ShapeLine`](#shapeline) | yes |  | A straight line. |

2. **Form 2**: An open polyline.

   Shape: object { `polyline`: [`ShapePoints`](#shapepoints) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `polyline` | [`ShapePoints`](#shapepoints) | yes |  | The points of a polyline or polygon, in order. |

3. **Form 3**: An axis-parallel rectangle.

   Shape: object { `rect`: [`ShapeRect`](#shaperect) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `rect` | [`ShapeRect`](#shaperect) | yes |  | An axis-parallel rectangle by two corners. |

4. **Form 4**: A circle.

   Shape: object { `circle`: [`ShapeCircle`](#shapecircle) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `circle` | [`ShapeCircle`](#shapecircle) | yes |  | A circle. |

5. **Form 5**: A circular arc.

   Shape: object { `arc`: [`ShapeArc`](#shapearc) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `arc` | [`ShapeArc`](#shapearc) | yes |  | A circular arc: centre, radius, start angle and signed sweep (`Angle2`, counter-clockwise positive in the mathematical sense of the page's y-down frame: a positive sweep turns from +x towards −y). |

6. **Form 6**: A closed polygon.

   Shape: object { `polygon`: [`ShapePoints`](#shapepoints) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `polygon` | [`ShapePoints`](#shapepoints) | yes |  | The points of a polyline or polygon, in order. |

### ImageItem

An image asset placed on the page (FR-SYM-025, WP-S2.04 §11): the asset's content hash (the project holds
`assets/<sha256>.<ext>`, checked by `item.place`) and the rectangle it is drawn in, `rect` as `[[x0, y0],
[x1, y1]]` in absolute page nanometres with `min <= max` (the reader rejects a reversed rectangle). An SVG is
drawn as vector paths, a PNG or JPEG as an image.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `asset` | [`Sha256`](#sha256) | yes |  | The asset. |
| `rect` | [`Rect`](#rect) | yes |  | The rectangle on the page. |

### LineDash

The dash pattern of a graphic or a structure box line.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"solid"` | Solid (the default). |
| `"dashed"` | Dashed. |
| `"dotted"` | Dotted. |
| `"dash_dot"` | Dash-dot. |

### MlText

Multilingual text: a neutral string, or an object keyed by canonical BCP 47 tags with non-empty string values (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express that all text is NFC or that the keys are in ascending byte order; the reader rejects both.

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**

   Shape: string

2. **Form 2**

   Shape: map of string (at least 1 character(s)) (at least 1 propert(ies))

### Nm

A length in nanometres (doc 05 §3.2). Written without fraction or exponent; JSON Schema cannot tell 5 from 5.0, the reader rejects the latter.

Type: integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991)

### Pt2

A point [x, y] in nanometres, y downwards (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: array of (integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991), integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991)) (at least 2 item(s), at most 2 item(s))

### Rect

A rectangle [[x0, y0], [x1, y1]] in nanometres, minimum corner first (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: array of ([`Pt2`](#pt2), [`Pt2`](#pt2)) (at least 2 item(s))

### Sha256

A SHA-256 digest sha256:&lt;64 lower-case hex> (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (pattern `^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$`)

Pattern: `^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$`

|---|---|---|---|---|

| `r` | [`Nm`](#nm) | yes |  | Radius. |

### SurfaceView

The view of one mounting surface on a panel-layout page (doc 12 §5.1, FR-LAY-010; WP-S4.01 D9): a surface point
`(u, v)` is drawn at `x = datum_at.x + u / n`, `y = datum_at.y − v / n` on a page of scale 1:n (paper `y` points
down), so `datum_at` is where the surface's origin lands on the page. Everything it draws (outlines, carriers,
footprints, labels) is derived, never stored (doc 12 §2.3). A panel-layout page holds at most one, set by
`page.surface_view.set`. Typed within format 0.1 under ADR-0011 amendment 4 (ID-334): `side`, `clip` and `layers`
stay verbatim in `SurfaceView::extra`.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `datum_at` | [`Pt2`](#pt2) | yes |  | Where the surface's origin lands on the page, in page nanometres. |
| `label_mode` | [`SurfaceLabelMode`](#surfacelabelmode) | no |  | How placements are labelled; default abbreviated. |
| `surface` | [`Uuid`](#uuid) | yes |  | The mounting surface shown; a deleted surface deletes the view with it (cascade). |

### SurfaceLabelMode

How a surface view labels its placements (FR-LAY-009, doc 12 §5.3).

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"abbreviated"` | The displayed tag on the view's page, identifier suppression against the page's structure ("-X1031"); the default. |
| `"full"` | The full designation ("=P01+J-E-2416-X1031"). |

### TextAlign

The horizontal alignment of a free text at its anchor point.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"left"` | The text starts at the point. |
| `"centre"` | The text is centred on the point. |
| `"right"` | The text ends at the point. |

### Uuid

A lower-case hyphenated UUID (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 36 character(s), at most 36 character(s))

Pattern: `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`

### WireMarker

The group marker of several connections (doc 03 §6, doc 08 §4.5, FR-CON-039): it stores only the list of its
connections in printed order, its position and angle (0 or 90000) and the fields it shows; the text is derived
from the connections' effective values. Every listed connection exists and lies on the marker's page
(EW-INV-023); a deleted connection leaves the list, and an empty marker is deleted with it.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `angle` | [`Angle2`](#angle2) | no |  | The angle; default 0. |
| `at` | [`Pt2`](#pt2) | yes |  | The anchor point of the group. |
| `connections` | array of [`Uuid`](#uuid) | yes |  | The connections, in printed order. |
| `fields` | array of [`MarkerField`](#markerfield) | yes |  | The fields shown, `["csa", "colour"]`. |

### MarkerField

A field a wire marker shows.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"csa"` | The cross-section. |
| `"colour"` | The colour codes. |
